dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped structures along the mid-to-posterior dorsal surface exhibit high-contrast, irregular perimeters. The edges transition sharply from light-toned boundaries to dark-toned interiors, with at least four prominent annuli displaying crenulated or jagged geometric outlines.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A large, amorphous region of saturated high-intensity pixels is concentrated on the anterior-dorsal (neck) area. Smaller, discrete low-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients are distributed across the mid-lateral flank as solid dark focal points.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent 'O' shaped macro-annuli on the mid-dorsal flank form an irregular trapezoidal configuration. A secondary cluster of three smaller 'C' shaped structures on the posterior-flank forms a tight triangular spatial relationship.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, high-reflectance white 'blaze' or large-scale amorphous patch is situated on the dorsal-neck region, distinct in size and intensity from the surrounding annular patterns.
